stock.description: Takbo Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the design, development, production, and worldwide sale of beauty-related goods. Its market presence extends across various regions, including Mainland China, North America (the United States, Mexico, and Canada), European nations such as Belgium and the United Kingdom, and other international territories. The company's diverse product range encompasses personal care cosmetics, including color makeup, shower gels, body lotions, fragrance mists, and perfumes. Additionally, it provides a variety of beauty accessories, such as tote bags, packaging bags, cosmetic bag sets, clutches, and small pouches. These offerings are marketed under its own brand names: Pink Viva, Secret Lace, and Gorgeous Girl Forever. Takbo Group's principal customers include retailers, proprietors of beauty product brands, and trading enterprises. The firm was established in 1994, with its main offices located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Classic Charm Investments Limited.
